changeSet.author: bookstore-service
changeSet.comment: Add indexes for specific repository query patterns identified in BookRepository, CategoryRepository, and InventoryRepository
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_categories_name_trgm ON categories USING gin(name gin_trgm_ops);

changeSet.author: bookstore-service
changeSet.comment: Add indexes for inventory-book join queries and availability checks
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_available_calc ON inventory ((quantity - reserved_quantity)) WHERE (quantity - reserved_quantity) > 0;
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_updated_at_desc ON inventory (updated_at DESC) WHERE updated_at IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: bookstore-service
changeSet.comment: Add indexes for complex book search queries with multiple filters
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_books_recent_available ON books (created_at DESC, id) WHERE available = true;
CREATE INDEX idx_books_title_available_lower ON books (LOWER(title), available, id) WHERE available = true;
CREATE INDEX idx_books_author_available_lower ON books (LOWER(author), available, id) WHERE available = true;

changeSet.author: bookstore-service
changeSet.comment: Add indexes for category-based inventory queries

changeSet.author: bookstore-service
changeSet.comment: Optimize ISBN lookups which are unique and frequently used
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_books_isbn_covering ON books (isbn, id, title, author, price, available) WHERE isbn IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_book_isbn ON inventory (book_id) INCLUDE (quantity, reserved_quantity, low_stock_threshold);

changeSet.author: bookstore-service
changeSet.comment: Add indexes for count and sum aggregation queries
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_books_available_count ON books (available) WHERE available = true;
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_reserved_count ON inventory (reserved_quantity) WHERE reserved_quantity > 0;
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_quantity_sum ON inventory (quantity) WHERE quantity > 0;
